title: Choose the visual world for Naruky
question: The roll assigned Bilbao Metro. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Bilbao Metro
options.lineage: Norman Foster's Metro Bilbao wayfinding: red disc, graphite steel, glass
options.thesis: Your tax year as a metro line: every payment is a station you can see coming.
options.viewport: Inputs in a left panel; headline take-home; a red line of the year with 130/303/390/Renta stations and 'you are here'.
options.risk: Reads as a Bilbao transport app if the line is used as decoration instead of the payment schedule.

raised.raise: Where each euro goes is one bar whose segment widths are exact shares that always sum to 100 %.
The line and the month table are one space: tapping a station jumps to its row and back.
The split of every payment can't overflow: what you keep + tax + RETA + set-aside = the invoice, to the cent.
Chrome deleted around the headline: the take-home number is the largest thing on screen, no card shell.
One graphite tonal ramp carries every neutral; red is reserved for money leaving you.

options.label: Savings passbook
options.lineage: Ощадна книжка / BBK libreta de ahorro: dated lines, running balance, guilloche paper
options.thesis: Your set-aside pot printed line by line, like the passbook both your countries grew up with.
options.viewport: Inputs left; headline; a dated table of inflows, payments and the running tax-reserve balance.
options.risk: Familiar finance look; easily slides into ruled-ledger costume and feels like a bank.

options.label: Midnight transit diagram
options.thesis: Each obligation (IRPF, RETA, IVA, Renta) is its own coloured line across the year.
options.viewport: Dark shell; four parallel coloured lines with payment stations.
options.case: Holds clarity (parallel obligations read well) but loses audience identification to the local Bilbao Metro.
options.risk: Dark, dense diagram is harder to read on a phone in daylight.

options.label: Metro typographic tiles
options.case: Loses both axes: no tie to Bilbao or Ukraine; panorama hides the schedule.
options.kept: Chrome deleted: the number is the interface.

options.label: Manual acetate tab board
options.thesis: Sections as tabs sized by extent.
options.risk: Reads as documentation, not a tool.
options.kept: Extent drawn proportionally: shares as exact widths.

options.label: Event circle catalog
options.thesis: Map and grid are one space.
options.kept: Map and table are one space (station ↔ month row).

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.thesis: Sides must not overflow the tape.
options.kept: A fixed budget that can't overflow: the payment split sums exactly.

options.label: Darkroom exposure record
options.thesis: One tonal ramp as the only tokens.
options.kept: A single tonal ramp for all neutrals.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fintech calculator: white cards, blue accent, results tiles.
canonCard.viewport: Form card left, result card with three stat tiles right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other tax calculator by design.
